summary: Single-process Java 8 arcade server. A dedicated platform thread runs a fixed 16 ms tick loop mutating a global static World; one blocking thread per TCP client decodes an undocumented big-endian binary protocol on port 7777. Scores are reported by clients and written to MySQL with string-built SQL. There is no authentication; a hardcoded admin password in the protocol can shut the server down.

components.name: GameServer
components.responsibility: Accepts raw TCP connections, spawns one thread per client, owns global client Vector and running flag, broadcasts state packets.

components.name: GameLoop
components.responsibility: Fixed-step physics tick (Thread.sleep(16)), speed ramp, scoring, obstacle spawn cadence, broadcast.

components.name: World / Player
components.responsibility: Mutable game state: players, obstacles, AABB collision, jump rules.

components.name: Protocol / ClientHandler
components.responsibility: Binary encode/decode of JOIN, JUMP, SCORE, STATE and ADMIN packets over blocking streams.

components.name: HighScoreStore
components.responsibility: Writes client-reported scores to MySQL via DriverManager + Statement; MD5 signature.

boundaries.description: All gameplay commands and admin shutdown cross this boundary without identity.
Blocking writes inside a global lock: a slow client stalls the whole tick.
Hardcoded root credentials; SQL injectable through player name.

transitions.trigger: ADMIN packet with hardcoded password and cmd=1

businessRules.title: Fixed 60 Hz tick
businessRules.rule: Simulation advances one step every 16 ms (~62.5 Hz); tick counter increments before any other update.

businessRules.title: Gravity integration
businessRules.rule: Each tick: vy += 0.6; y += vy (semi-implicit Euler). Ground at y=300 clamps y and zeroes vy.

businessRules.title: Jump impulse
businessRules.rule: Jump sets vy = -11.0 px/tick and state JUMPING.

businessRules.title: No double jump
businessRules.rule: Jump is only accepted when state == RUNNING and y >= GROUND_Y.

businessRules.title: Speed ramp
businessRules.rule: World speed starts at 4.0 px/tick, increases by 0.001 every tick, capped at 14.0.

businessRules.title: Distance scoring with multiplier
businessRules.rule: score = floor(distance / 10) × (speed > 8 ? 2 : 1), recomputed every tick from cumulative distance.

businessRules.title: Obstacle cadence
businessRules.rule: Spawn when tick % max(30, floor(90 × 4.0 / speed)) == 0, at x=800 with width 16–39 and height 20–49.

businessRules.title: Collision
businessRules.rule: Player box x∈[80,104); hit when x-overlap and y > 300 − obstacleHeight. Collision sets DEAD; dead players stop updating.

businessRules.title: Score submission
businessRules.rule: Legacy accepts any client-claimed score (CWE-602). Modern rule: only the server-computed score of a finished (DEAD) run may be recorded; player names match ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,16}$.

timing.notes: Thread.sleep after work means effective period = 16 ms + step + broadcast time; slow clients block broadcast and stretch ticks. Modern target uses scheduleAtFixedRate(16 ms) for drift-free cadence.

protocols.name: CyberRunner wire protocol v1
protocols.transport: TCP :7777, big-endian DataInput/OutputStream, no framing or auth

messages.name: STATE
messages.legacyLayout: [u8 op][i64 tick][f32 speed][u8 n]{[i32 id][f32 y][i32 score][u8 state]}×n

messages.name: ADMIN
messages.modernEvent: REMOVED — operational control via authenticated management plane only

issues: Unbounded name length up to 255 bytes, platform default charset
No message framing/version; one malformed byte desynchronizes the stream

vulnerabilities.description: Deserialization RCE in SocketServer; Log4j 1.x is EOL.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Replace with SLF4J/Logback via Spring Boot 3.3.4.
Managed JDBC driver via Spring Data JPA.

vulnerabilities.description: Player name concatenated into INSERT statement.
Hardcoded admin password and MySQL root credentials (also logged).
vulnerabilities.remediation: Remove admin opcode; credentials from AWS Secrets Manager.

vulnerabilities.description: No authentication on any operation including shutdown.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Spring Security 6 + Cognito JWT at the edge.

vulnerabilities.description: Client-side enforcement of score; arbitrary high-score injection.

concurrencyIssues.issue: Thread.sleep(16) after work causes tick drift and burns a platform thread.
Static synchronized method performs blocking socket writes; one slow client stalls all clients and the tick.
Global static mutable World shared across threads with coarse synchronized blocks; ClientHandler.nextId++ is a data race.
concurrencyIssues.remediation: Encapsulated GameEngine with ReentrantLock and AtomicInteger ids.

complianceFindings.finding: Cleartext DB root password in JDBC URL.
Client IP addresses and synthesized email addresses written to logs.
Unpinned transitive dependencies resolved from the public internet at build time.
complianceFindings.remediation: Hermetic pre-warmed build image, offline Maven in VPC-isolated CodeBuild.

modernizationPlan.description: Java 21 + Spring Boot 3.3.4 baseline; drop log4j 1.x, commons-collections, mysql 5.1.
Global static World → GameEngine with ReentrantLock.
Binary protocol → STOMP events (JoinCommand, JumpCommand, StateEvent).
Remove SCORE opcode; ScoreService records server-computed scores only.
Remove ADMIN opcode; authenticate all endpoints.
